messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated container restarts in gpu-pool-7 detected (prefill path). Error rate spike 03:10 UTC. Link: https://redwood/in/c/1732109876

eric (oncall): taking pager, looking. which regions / models?

mike (sre): hitting repeated container restarts on us-west clusters. Prefill flows for large-context (>80k tokens) generate steady GPU mem growth until SIGKILL. sample log:

```
[2026-03-12T03:09:41Z] runtime: alloc kernel failed: CUDA out of memory
[2026-03-12T03:09:42Z] prefill: kv_cache bytes=3123456789 allocations=3
[2026-03-12T03:09:43Z] container: process 4123 killed (signal 9)
```

sara (runtime): looks like KV cache accumulation from repeated prefetch/prefill of massive contexts. I can push hotpatch to disable prefetch for requests with prefills >65536 tokens and fall back to streaming CPU coldmodel. prepping patch now.

iris (support): CS is seeing ~4% 5xx for production keyspace. Two customers reported errors: acme-corp (high priority) and beta-inc (low). Drafting customer-facing note, ETA 20m.

mike (sre): mitigation plan (short): 1) disable prefetch for large-context requests, 2) route >64k token prefills to coldmodel fallback, 3) scale hotpool +2 nodes in us-west, 4) throttle max_prefill_tokens at API gateway to 65k for non-whitelisted keys. Applying in that order.

eric (oncall): I can flip the throttle now. Which config path?

mike (sre): run: `./infractl set-config runtime.prefill.max_allowed_tokens 65536 --env prod --region us-west` then `./infractl scale hotpool.us-west +2`

eric (oncall): running throttle now.

deploy-bot: Deploy request submitted by eric (oncall): config runtime.prefill.max_allowed_tokens=65536 -> started. CI: ✅  | Rolling to 12/15 nodes in us-west.

sara (runtime): hotpatch to skip prefetch for large contexts pushed to runtime (v3.4.1-hotpatch1). Disabling prefetch flag: `PREFETCH_LONG_PREFILL=false` for pool gpu-pool-7.

mike (sre): scaled hotpool +2 nodes applied. Observed immediate drop in OOM restarts count from 22/min -> 4/min in first 3m. One noisy node still flapping: gpunode-7a3f. I'll drain and reprovision it.

iris (support): customer note draft: "We identified a memory pressure issue affecting long-context generation; we've applied throttles and fallbacks to mitigate errors. We're monitoring and will follow up in 1h." Link to draft: https://redwood/docs/incidents/1732109876-draft

eric (oncall): draining gpunode-7a3f now. set `kubectl cordon` + `drain` in progress.

sara (runtime): after hotpatch: KV cache growth stopped on affected pods. avg memory stable. Still tracking tail errors due to in-flight sessions that hit old config.

mike (sre): node reprovisioned, restarts down to baseline. telemetry: 5xx down from 4% -> 0.6% over 10m. Will keep autoscale bump for 40m then reassess.

eric (oncall): handing off to lisa at 14:00 UTC. leaving notes: actions performed, PR link, hotpatch id, customer draft link. @lisa please monitor customer errors and confirm remediate.

lisa (oncall): ack, i'll take it from here. ping me if you see new restarts.

incident-bot: Incident update: mitigation applied (prefetch disabled for large contexts, gateway throttle, hotpool scale). Current status: degraded -> stable. Incident moved to monitoring.

iris (support): sending customer updates now.

mike (sre): postmortem items: 1) add guardrail in runtime to cap KV cache growth per-request, 2) automated routing for >64k token prefills to CPU fallback by default, 3) better per-request instrumentation for prefill memory growth. I'll own 1 & 3.

eric (oncall): thanks team. closing pager.

incident-bot: Incident resolved (monitoring) at 03:30 UTC. Follow-up: postmortem assigned to mike.
